name: Sandbound
source: Pathfinder Howl of the Wild, Sandbound adjustment (pg. 123), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/MonsterTemplates.aspx?ID=27
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder Howl of the Wild is ORC licensed material.
rules: Adds resistance to fire and weakness to cold 3, 5, 10 or 15 by level (3 or lower, 4-8, 9-13, 14+), a burrow Speed of half its fastest Speed if it has none, and Efficient Metabolism, Scorching Adaptation, Desert Steps and Sand Burst.

abilities.name: Efficient Metabolism
abilities.description: {Name} can go 10 times as long as normal before it's affected by starvation and thirst.

abilities.name: Scorching Adaptation
abilities.description: {Name} treats environmental heat effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible heat becomes extreme, extreme heat becomes severe, and so on).

abilities.name: Desert Steps
abilities.description: {Name} ignores uneven ground and difficult terrain caused by sand (reducing greater difficult terrain from sand to ordinary difficult terrain).

abilities.name: Sand Burst
abilities.description: Requirements {Name} is burrowed in loose sand or earth; Effect {Name} Burrows twice, then makes a melee Strike. If it was undetected at the start of its movement, it remains undetected until after the attack.
